name: Voix et musique (HT Demucs)
description: Splits the sound of the selected clip with the HT Demucs network (optional model htdemucs, 84 MB, MIT): the voice alone, or everything but the voice (the music without the voice), or the four stems (drums, bass, other, vocals). The results are new 32-bit float WAV files imported into the project; the original is not touched. About 2x real time on Metal. Variables: --var stems=vocals,rest,drums,bass,other.
author: FilmCraft

entries.label: Isoler la voix
entries.description: A new audio file with the voice only (music, drums and noise removed as far as the network can).

entries.label: Retirer la voix (garder la musique)
entries.description: A new audio file with everything except the voice.

entries.label: Les quatre pistes
entries.description: Drums, bass, other and vocals as four files.
